---
title: "Covariate Balance Love Plot"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(cobalt)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

options(scipen = 999)
```

## 1. Paths

```{r paths}
INPUT_PATH <- here(
  "data",
  "derived",
  "ebal_att_long.rds"
)

OUTPUT_DIR <- here(
  "data",
  "derived"
)

stopifnot(file.exists(INPUT_PATH))

dir.create(
  OUTPUT_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

## 2. Load entropy-balanced multiply imputed data

```{r load-data}
bal_dat <- readRDS(INPUT_PATH)

required_vars <- c(
  ".imp",
  "group_w",
  "att_weight_ebal"
)

missing_vars <- setdiff(required_vars, names(bal_dat))

if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required variables: ",
    paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

stopifnot(
  dplyr::n_distinct(bal_dat$.imp) == 20L,
  all(is.finite(bal_dat$att_weight_ebal)),
  all(bal_dat$att_weight_ebal > 0)
)

cat("Rows:", nrow(bal_dat), "\n")
cat("Imputations:", dplyr::n_distinct(bal_dat$.imp), "\n")
```

## 3. Covariate specification

```{r formula}
ATT_FORMULA <- group_w ~
  hinc +
  hgowner +
  size +
  smallspace +
  livedhere +
  east +
  hhgr +
  rel_duration +
  syear +
  M_age +
  M_life_sat +
  M_germborn +
  M_migration +
  M_germcitz +
  M_employment +
  M_edu_level +
  F_age +
  F_life_sat +
  F_germborn +
  F_migration +
  F_germcitz +
  F_employment +
  F_edu_level
```

## 4. Balance object across the 20 imputations

```{r balance-object}
bal_mi <- cobalt::bal.tab(
  ATT_FORMULA,
  data = bal_dat,
  weights = "att_weight_ebal",
  imp = ".imp",
  un = TRUE,
  stats = "mean.diffs",
  s.d.denom = "pooled",
  continuous = "std",
  binary = "std",
  poly = 1,
  abs = TRUE,
  quick = FALSE
)

print(bal_mi)
```

## 5. Publication labels

```{r labels}
nice_names <- c(
  hinc           = "Household income",
  hgowner        = "Homeownership",
  size           = "Dwelling size",
  smallspace     = "Adequacy of living space",
  livedhere      = "Years at current residence",
  east           = "East Germany",
  hhgr           = "Household size",
  rel_duration   = "Relationship duration",
  syear          = "Survey year",

  M_age          = "Male partner: Age",
  M_life_sat     = "Male partner: Baseline life satisfaction",
  M_germborn     = "Male partner: Born in Germany",
  M_migration    = "Male partner: Migration background",
  M_germcitz     = "Male partner: German citizenship",
  M_employment   = "Male partner: Employment",
  M_edu_level    = "Male partner: Education",

  F_age          = "Female partner: Age",
  F_life_sat     = "Female partner: Baseline life satisfaction",
  F_germborn     = "Female partner: Born in Germany",

```

## 6. Main/supplement Love plot

Points represent the mean absolute standardized mean difference across the 20 imputations. Horizontal ranges represent the minimum-to-maximum balance statistic across imputations.

```{r love-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=9}
p_balance <- cobalt::love.plot(
  bal_mi,
  stats = "mean.diffs",
  abs = TRUE,

  # Aggregate balance across multiply imputed datasets.
  which.imp = .none,
  agg.fun = "range",

  # Conventional balance threshold.
  thresholds = c(m = 0.10),

  # Order by pre-weighting imbalance.
  var.order = "unadjusted",

  # Labels.
  var.names = nice_names,
  factor_sep = ": ",

  # Styling.
  line = TRUE,
  colors = c("grey55", "black"),
  shapes = c("triangle filled", "circle filled"),
  sample.names = c(
    "Before weighting",
    "After entropy balancing"
  ),
  size = 3,
  wrap = 40,
  position = "top"
) +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute standardized mean difference",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black"
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 9.2,
      colour = "black"
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 11,
      margin = margin(t = 8)
    ),

    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5,
      r = 12,
      b = 8,
      l = 5
    )
  )

p_balance
```

## 7. Save publication files

```{r save-figure}
PNG_PATH <- here(
  "data", "derived",
  "Figure_covariate_balance_entropy_ATT.png"
)

PDF_PATH <- here(
  "data", "derived",
  "Figure_covariate_balance_entropy_ATT.pdf"
)

ggsave(
  PNG_PATH,
  p_balance,
  width = 8,
  height = 9,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  PDF_PATH,
  p_balance,
  width = 8,
  height = 9,
  units = "in"
)

cat("Saved:\n")
cat(PNG_PATH, "\n")
cat(PDF_PATH, "\n")
```
